'''Perwyn Belman''' is a very young [[Darkfriend]]. His mother is [[Nan Belman]].

== Activities ==
[[Padan Fain]] comes to stay in Nan's house to be near [[Rand al'Thor]]. Perwyn comes to Fain calling him Mordeth and brings him news that a [[Gray Man]] tried to kill Rand. 

Fain reacts badly to this, losing his temper and hurting Perwyn by simply touching him, causing him to tremble and start gibbering. Fain believes that Perwyn will survive what he did to him, but doesn't really care.{{ref/book|6|28}}
